description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldName, a specialized widget for displaying and handling 'name' fields within reports and lists in the SuiteCRM system. It extends the base class SugarWidgetFieldVarchar and includes methods for rendering list views, generating SQL for filtering, and grouping data, specifically focusing on concatenated or linked name fields associated with records. It also manages permissions and inline editing functionalities for name fields in reports.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldName
classes.description: A widget class responsible for rendering name fields in lists and reports, handling concatenation of name parts, link generation, inline editing, and various filtering mechanisms within the SuiteCRM reporting framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the widget with layout manager, reporter, and associated ID widget.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying the name field as a link, with optional inline editing features, based on layout definitions.

methods.name: _get_normal_column_select
methods.description: Returns SQL select statement for normal columns, either concatenating fields or defaulting to parent method.

methods.name: _get_column_select
methods.description: Generates SQL for concatenated or formatted name fields based on locale and layout definitions.

methods.name: queryFilterIs
methods.description: Creates SQL filter clause for filtering records by ID equality.

methods.name: queryFilteris_not
methods.description: Creates SQL filter clause for filtering records by ID inequality.

methods.name: queryFilterone_of
methods.description: Creates SQL filter clause for filtering records where ID is in a set of values.

methods.name: queryFilternot_one_of
methods.description: Creates SQL filter clause for filtering records where ID is not in a set of values.

methods.name: queryGroupBy
methods.description: Returns SQL GROUP BY clause to group results by the name or ID.
